integrity: Analytic proof supplied for all dimensions; finite computations are corroboration, not infinite certification. Mathematical originality reviewed with disclosed incomplete-source risk.
scientific_limitations: Flat two-point opening on real finite cycles with uniform centered Euclidean seminorm only. Sharp saturation and strict pre-saturation are proved, but the exact intermediate constants for cycles of 3 through 7 sites, longer windows, weighted settings and other boundaries are not determined. An unindexed equivalent antecedent remains possible.
title: Eight-site saturation of the centered-Hilbert stability bound for cyclic morphological opening
